reviews.review_description: For 99 cents this is a must play, iv replayed it five times, and am going to play more.  It's fun trying to figure out what's going on,  and then when you do you can replay it and make different choices that changes the story and there's a few different endings, so it's a must play again type of game.  The whole game is fun and I love the little game we get to play in the car. The story is good and sad with a big twist, it really makes me feel bad for the the little girl we're playing as. Great job  developers,  if there's an update,  I'd love it if the mirrors in the car would really work,  but I can understand if that's how you wanted it to be,  it makes you have to turn around to look out the back window.  But hands would be nice. Really good job 👏 👍
